text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, so noisy!
Isn't the crowd being a bit too rowdy?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, go outside and make them quiet down!
Or rather, go give them a piece of your mind!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to make such a fuss.
Magical Girl Sweepy's gonna win by a landslide anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is watch from over there.
The magic of a grand genius is the strongest, after all!!
